svg.aria-label: Left: a row read sends the 32 lanes to 32 different banks, a column read of a 32-wide tile sends all lanes to the same bank, and padding to 33 spreads them out again. Right: a column read costs gcd(width, 32) passes, so any odd width is conflict-free
